We present CliffSearch, an agentic evolutionary framework in which the core evolution operators (pair selection, crossover, mutation, and review) are implemented as LLM agents, and the loop is designed around three principles: (1) each node is a structured scientific artifact, instantiated in either theory+code or code_only mode, (2) reviewer judgments of correctness and originality are first-class selection gates alongside optimization of the benchmark metric of interest, and (3) mutation is split into exploration and correction pathways with distinct objectives. Exploration mutation imports ideas from adjacent scientific domains to increase novelty, while correction mutation performs targeted evidence-guided repair using reviewer signals over theory, code, benchmark results, and runtime errors. We illustrate the framework on three benchmark-grounded studies: transformer hyper-connection evolution, optimizer discovery on a fixed nanoGPT stack, and a smaller native-optimizer ablation. Across these settings, the same loop supports explicit metric direction, reproducible persistence, and reviewer-gated comparison of discoveries under controlled search conditions. The result is a discovery workflow that prioritizes scientific interpretability and correctness while optimizing task metrics under controlled novelty constraints, rather than maximizing candidate throughput alone. Full run artifacts, interactive visualizations, and exported best nodes for the reported studies are available at https://cliffsearch.ai .

AI.tldr: CliffSearch是一个基于LLM智能体的进化框架，用于科学算法发现。其核心创新在于将进化算子（选择、交叉、变异、审查）实现为LLM智能体，并以结构化科学产物作为进化节点，同时引入正确性和原创性作为一级选择门控。变异操作被分为探索性和修正性两条路径，分别负责引入跨领域新思想和基于证据的定向修复。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM引导的搜索系统在科学算法发现中存在两个主要缺陷：(1) 过度优化代码层面的产物，忽视科学结构；(2) 正确性和原创性门控机制薄弱。这导致生成的算法难以保证科学可解释性和有效性。
AI.method: CliffSearch框架基于三个设计原则：(1) 节点表示为结构化科学产物，支持theory+code或code_only两种模式；(2) 审查者的正确性和原创性判断作为一级选择门控，与基准指标优化并列；(3) 变异操作分为探索性和修正性两条路径。探索性变异从相邻科学领域引入新思想以提升新颖性；修正性变异利用审查反馈对理论、代码、基准结果和运行时错误进行定向修复。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试场景中验证了框架有效性：Transformer超连接进化、固定nanoGPT栈上的优化器发现，以及原生优化器消融实验。框架支持显式指标优化、可复现持久化和受控搜索条件下的审查门控比较。
AI.conclusion: CliffSearch提供了一种优先考虑科学可解释性和正确性的发现工作流，在新颖性约束下优化任务指标，而非单纯追求候选吞吐量。该框架将LLM能力与科学方法论相结合，为自动化科学发现提供了更严谨的范式。

title: The Recipe Matters More Than the Kitchen:Mathematical Foundations of the AI Weather Prediction Pipeline
summary: AI weather prediction has advanced rapidly, yet no unified mathematical framework explains what determines forecast skill. Existing theory addresses specific architectural choices rather than the learning pipeline as a whole, while operational evidence from 2023-2026 demonstrates that training methodology, loss function design, and data diversity matter at least as much as architecture selection. This paper makes two interleaved contributions. Theoretically, we construct a framework rooted in approximation theory on the sphere, dynamical systems theory, information theory, and statistical learning theory that treats the complete learning pipeline (architecture, loss function, training strategy, data distribution) rather than architecture alone. We establish a Learning Pipeline Error Decomposition showing that estimation error (loss- and data-dependent) dominates approximation error (architecture-dependent) at current scales. We develop a Loss Function Spectral Theory formalizing MSE-induced spectral blurring in spherical harmonic coordinates, and derive Out-of-Distribution Extrapolation Bounds proving that data-driven models systematically underestimate record-breaking extremes with bias growing linearly in record exceedance. Empirically, we validate these predictions via inference across ten architecturally diverse AI weather models using NVIDIA Earth2Studio with ERA5 initial conditions, evaluating six metrics across 30 initialization dates spanning all seasons. Results confirm universal spectral energy loss at high wavenumbers for MSE-trained models, rising Error Consensus Ratios showing that the majority of forecast error is shared across architectures, and linear negative bias during extreme events. A Holistic Model Assessment Score provides unified multi-dimensional evaluation, and a prescriptive framework enables mathematical evaluation of proposed pipelines before training.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一数学框架，从近似理论、动力系统理论、信息论和统计学习理论角度分析AI天气预报的学习 pipeline。核心发现是：当前尺度下估计误差（依赖损失函数和数据）主导近似误差（依赖架构），MSE训练导致球谐坐标下高频能量损失，十种架构间的误差共识比例上升，且模型系统性低估破纪录极端事件（偏差与记录超出量线性相关）。通过NVIDIA Earth2Studio在ERA5数据上验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: AI天气预报快速发展，但缺乏统一数学框架解释预报技巧的决定因素。现有理论仅针对特定架构选择，未考虑完整学习 pipeline。2023-2026年的业务实践表明，训练方法、损失函数设计和数据多样性至少与架构选择同等重要，亟需从理论层面建立系统化理解。
AI.method: 理论层面：基于球面近似理论、动力系统理论、信息论和统计学习理论构建统一框架，对完整学习 pipeline（架构、损失函数、训练策略、数据分布）进行数学建模。提出"学习 pipeline 误差分解"（Learning Pipeline Error Decomposition）、"损失函数谱理论"（Loss Function Spectral Theory）和"分布外推界限"（Out-of-Distribution Extrapolation Bounds）。实证层面：使用NVIDIA Earth2Studio，以ERA5为初始场，对10种不同架构的AI天气模型进行推理，评估6个指标，涵盖30个初始化日期覆盖所有季节。
AI.result: 实验验证了理论预测：MSE训练的模型在高频波数普遍存在谱能量损失；误差共识比率（Error Consensus Ratios）上升表明大多数预报误差在各架构间共享；极端事件期间存在线性负偏差。模型在记录破纪录极端事件上的偏差与超出量呈线性增长关系。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次建立了解释AI天气预报技巧的统一数学框架，证明了估计误差在当前规模下主导近似误差，为损失函数设计和数据策略提供了理论依据。提出了"整体模型评估分数"（Holistic Model Assessment Score）用于多维统一评估，以及可训练的 prescriptive 框架支持 pipeline 数学评估。

title: LAtent Phase Inference from Short time sequences using SHallow REcurrent Decoders (LAPIS-SHRED)
summary: Reconstructing full spatio-temporal dynamics from sparse observations in both space and time remains a central challenge in complex systems, as measurements can be spatially incomplete and can be also limited to narrow temporal windows. Yet approximating the complete spatio-temporal trajectory is essential for mechanistic insight and understanding, model calibration, and operational decision-making. We introduce LAPIS-SHRED (LAtent Phase Inference from Short time sequence using SHallow REcurrent Decoders), a modular architecture that reconstructs and/or forecasts complete spatiotemporal dynamics from sparse sensor observations confined to short temporal windows. LAPIS-SHRED operates through a three-stage pipeline: (i) a SHRED model is pre-trained entirely on simulation data to map sensor time-histories into a structured latent space, (ii) a temporal sequence model, trained on simulation-derived latent trajectories, learns to propagate latent states forward or backward in time to span unobserved temporal regions from short observational time windows, and (iii) at deployment, only a short observation window of hyper-sparse sensor measurements from the true system is provided, from which the frozen SHRED model and the temporal model jointly reconstruct or forecast the complete spatiotemporal trajectory. The framework supports bidirectional inference, inherits data assimilation and multiscale reconstruction capabilities from its modular structure, and accommodates extreme observational constraints including single-frame terminal inputs. We evaluate LAPIS-SHRED on six experiments spanning complex spatio-temporal physics: turbulent flows, multiscale propulsion physics, volatile combustion transients, and satellite-derived environmental fields, highlighting a lightweight, modular architecture suited for operational settings where observation is constrained by physical or logistical limitations.

AI.tldr: LAPIS-SHRED是一种用于从稀疏时空观测中重建/预测完整时空动力学的模块化架构，通过三阶段管道（SHRED传感器映射→潜空间时序传播→部署推理）实现，即使在极端观测约束（如单帧终端输入）下也能运行，已在湍流、推进、燃烧及卫星环境场等六类复杂时空物理问题中验证有效。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏时空观测重建完整时空动力学是复杂系统的核心挑战。实际测量在空间上不完整、时间上受限，但完整时空轨迹对于机理理解、模型校准和决策至关重要。
AI.method: 提出LAPIS-SHRED架构，采用三阶段管道：(i) SHRED模型在仿真数据上预训练，将传感器历史映射到结构化潜空间；(ii) 时序模型在仿真潜轨迹上训练，学习向前/向后传播潜状态；(iii) 部署时仅需短观测窗口的稀疏传感器测量，结合冻结的SHRED和时序模型重建/预测完整时空轨迹。支持双向推理和数据同化，可处理单帧终端输入等极端约束。
AI.result: 在六个复杂时空物理实验上验证：湍流、多尺度推进物理、挥发性燃烧瞬态、卫星环境场。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有轻量级、模块化特点，适合物理或后勤限制导致观测受限的实际操作场景。

title: Model-Based Learning of Near-Optimal Finite-Window Policies in POMDPs
summary: We study model-based learning of finite-window policies in tabular partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). A common approach to learning under partial observability is to approximate unbounded history dependencies using finite action-observation windows. This induces a finite-state Markov decision process (MDP) over histories, referred to as the superstate MDP. Once a model of this superstate MDP is available, standard MDP algorithms can be used to compute optimal policies, motivating the need for sample-efficient model estimation. Estimating the superstate MDP model is challenging because trajectories are generated by interaction with the original POMDP, creating a mismatch between the sampling process and target model. We propose a model estimation procedure for tabular POMDPs and analyze its sample complexity. Our analysis exploits a connection between filter stability and concentration inequalities for weakly dependent random variables. As a result, we obtain tight sample complexity guarantees for estimating the superstate MDP model from a single trajectory. Combined with value iteration, this yields approximately optimal finite-window policies for the POMDP.

AI.tldr: 研究了表格型POMDP中有限窗口策略的基于模型学习方法，通过利用滤波器稳定性与弱依赖随机变量浓度不等式之间的联系，提出了一种模型估计程序，获得了从单条轨迹估计超状态MDP模型的紧样本复杂度界，结合价值迭代可获得近似最优的有限窗口策略。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程(POMDP)中学习策略时，一个常用方法是利用有限的动作-观测历史窗口来近似无限的历史依赖。然而，估计超状态MDP模型面临采样过程与目标模型之间的不匹配挑战，这使得样本高效模型估计变得困难。
AI.method: 1) 将POMDP中有限历史窗口诱导的有限状态MDP称为超状态MDP；2) 利用滤波器稳定性(filter stability)与弱依赖随机变量浓度不等式之间的联系进行分析；3) 提出针对表格型POMDP的模型估计程序。
AI.result: 获得了从单条轨迹估计超状态MDP模型的紧样本复杂度保证。
AI.conclusion: 结合价值迭代方法，所提出的方法能够获得POMDP的近似最优有限窗口策略，证明了有限窗口方法在样本效率上的理论可行性。

title: Reconsidering Dependency Networks from an Information Geometry Perspective
summary: Dependency networks (Heckerman et al., 2000) provide a flexible framework for modeling complex systems with many variables by combining independently learned local conditional distributions through pseudo-Gibbs sampling. Despite their computational advantages over Bayesian and Markov networks, the theoretical foundations of dependency networks remain incomplete, primarily because their model distributions -- defined as stationary distributions of pseudo-Gibbs sampling -- lack closed-form expressions. This paper develops an information-geometric analysis of pseudo-Gibbs sampling, interpreting each sampling step as an m-projection onto a full conditional manifold. Building on this interpretation, we introduce the full conditional divergence and derive an upper bound that characterizes the location of the stationary distribution in the space of probability distributions. We then reformulate both structure and parameter learning as optimization problems that decompose into independent subproblems for each node, and prove that the learned model distribution converges to the true underlying distribution as the number of training samples grows to infinity. Experiments confirm that the proposed upper bound is tight in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息几何视角重新审视依赖网络（dependency networks）：将伪 Gibbs 采样的每一步更新解释为对「全条件流形」的 m-投影，引入「全条件散度 FC」并给出刻画平稳分布位置的上界（FC-limit）；进而把结构学习与参数学习重写为可按节点独立分解的代价最小化问题，并证明训练样本趋于无穷时模型分布几乎必然收敛到真实分布；实验表明该上界在实践中很紧。
AI.motivation: 依赖网络通过独立学习各节点的全条件分布 p(X_i|X_{-i})，再以伪 Gibbs 采样组合成联合分布，学习代价可按节点分解，因此相比贝叶斯网络/马尔可夫网络在大变量数场景下计算上更有优势。然而其模型分布被定义为马尔可夫链的平稳分布，缺乏闭式表达，导致最大似然估计无法直接适用，理论 foundations 一直不完整：Heckerman 等 (2000) 将伪 Gibbs 采样视为标准 Gibbs 采样的"扰动"，但转移矩阵的微小改变可能大幅改变平稳分布，该论证不具一般性；作者此前 (Takabatake & Akaho 2012, 2021) 与 Kuo & Wang (2019) 已给出 m-投影的几何解释但未形成完整发表体系，缺少对平稳分布位置的定量刻画、学习目标函数的理论依据以及一致收敛性保证。
AI.method: （1）信息几何框架：定义节点 i 的全条件流形 E(θ_i)={p: p(X_i|X_{-i})=θ_i(X_i|X_{-i})}，证明其同时 e-平坦与 m-平坦（定理1）；证明更新节点 i 等价于把当前分布 m-投影到 E(θ_i)，即 pΠ_m(E(θ_i))=p(X_{-i})θ_i(X_i|X_{-i})（定理2），且该投影是线性的；伪 Gibbs 采样可视为 n+1 玩家各最小化自身 KL 代价的战略博弈，(π,{π_i}) 构成 Nash 均衡。顺序扫描产生非齐次链，其平稳极限为 π^0→…→π^{n-1}→π^0 的循环轨道质心。（2）引入全条件散度 FC(p||q)=Σ_i c_i KL(p||E_i(q))，它是 KL 散度的"Bregman 推广"（由加权负条件熵诱导），并与 Besag 伪似然一一对应（最小化 FC 等价于最大化伪似然）；证明 FC(p||q)≤KL(p||q)。（3）主结果（定理3）：FC(p||π)≤Σ_i c_i KL(p||E(θ_i))，右端称为 p 的 FC-limit，从而把"条件分布表接近真全条件 ⇒ 平稳分布接近目标分布"的假设严格化。（4）学习：将结构与参数学习统一为 min_{Y_i,θ_i} cost(Y_i,θ_i)=Σ_i c_i cost_i，其中 cost_i=KL(p^D||E(θ_i))+R(k_i,N)，R 为 MDL 罚项；定理4给出参数学习解 θ_i^min=p^D(X_i|Y_i) 且 KL(p^D||E(θ_i^min))=H(p^D(X_i|Y_i))−H(p^D(X_i|X_{-i}))；结构学习化为最小化 cost'_i(Y_i)=H(p^D(X_i|Y_i))+R(k_i,N)，与 Quinlan & Rivest (1989)/ID3 的代价一致；用基于 Chickering 等 (2013) 决策图构造的 split/merge 算子生成候选，贪心搜索并以叶代价 Lcost 局部增量 Δ 实现高效评估，同时记录操作序列以便推断时重建 Y。（5）一致性：定理5、定理6在"无损信息源 Y^ll 属于候选集、罚项非负且趋于零、强大律成立、p^*(x)>0"条件下证明 KL(p^D(N)||E(θ_i(N)))→0 且 π(N)(x)→p^*(x) 几乎必然。（6）推断：分析条件伪 Gibbs 采样（钳位变量），将 KL(p||E(θ_i)) 分解为对钳位值 x_C 的加权平均，指出稀有事件推断精度可能不足，且每个查询各自生成平稳分布，缺乏一致的联合分布。
AI.result: 理论上：得到 E(θ_i) 的双重平坦性、m-投影刻画、FC≤KL 不等式与 FC-limit 上界（定理3），并给出参数学习闭式解与结构学习的熵化简代价；证明模型分布随样本量趋于无穷几乎必然收敛到真实分布 p*。实验上：在 Ising4x3S/L（1,000 与 100,000 样本）与 RB12-21S/L（12 节点 21 边贝叶斯网络数据）四个数据集上，通过线性方程精确求解平稳分布 π，比较 FC(p^D||π) 与 FC_lim(p^D)：分别为 4.0e-3/5.3e-3、1.1e-3/1.1e-3、1.5e-1/1.6e-1、6.8e-3/7.4e-3（单位 nat），二者差距极小，验证了 FC-limit 上界在实践中是紧的。
AI.conclusion: 依赖网络虽无闭式联合分布，但通过信息几何可以刻画其平稳分布：伪 Gibbs 采样即对全条件流形的迭代 m-投影，全条件散度 FC 与 FC-limit 提供了"条件表误差 ⇒ 平稳分布误差"的定量传递机制，并因此给出一个有原则的学习目标函数——其最小化最终归结为最小化条件熵加复杂度罚项，从而保留了依赖网络"学习按节点完全分解"的核心计算优势。作者证明了所学模型分布对真实分布的一致收敛，并对条件伪 Gibbs 采样的推断给出一致性缺失与稀有事件精度下降的理论说明。后续方向可包括：连续变量推广、更紧的 FC-limit 界、避免局部贪心结构搜索次优性的算法，以及在存在一致联合分布需求时的推断改进。

title: Toward Personalized Darts Training: A Data-Driven Framework Based on Skeleton-Based Biomechanical Analysis and Motion Modeling
summary: As sports training becomes more data-driven, traditional dart coaching based mainly on experience and visual observation is increasingly inadequate for high-precision, goal-oriented movements. Although prior studies have highlighted the importance of release parameters, joint motion, and coordination in dart throwing, most quantitative methods still focus on local variables, single-release metrics, or static template matching. These approaches offer limited support for personalized training and often overlook useful movement variability. This paper presents a data-driven dart training assistance system. The system creates a closed-loop framework spanning motion capture, feature modeling, and personalized feedback. Dart-throwing data were collected in markerless conditions using a Kinect 2.0 depth sensor and an optical camera. Eighteen kinematic features were extracted from four biomechanical dimensions: three-link coordination, release velocity, multi-joint angular configuration, and postural stability. Two modules were developed: a personalized optimal throwing trajectory model that combines historical high-quality samples with the minimum jerk criterion, and a motion deviation diagnosis and recommendation model based on z-scores and hierarchical logic. A total of 2,396 throwing samples from professional and non-professional athletes were collected. Results show that the system generates smooth personalized reference trajectories consistent with natural human movement. Case studies indicate that it can detect poor trunk stability, abnormal elbow displacement, and imbalanced velocity control, then provide targeted recommendations. The framework shifts dart evaluation from deviation from a uniform standard to deviation from an individual's optimal control range, improving personalization and interpretability for darts training and other high-precision target sports.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个数据驱动的飞镖训练辅助系统，采用闭环框架（动作捕捉→特征建模→个性化反馈），从4个生物力学维度提取18个运动学特征，开发了个性化最优投掷轨迹模型和运动偏差诊断推荐模型，收集2396个样本验证了系统的有效性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统飞镖教学依赖经验和视觉观察，难以满足高精度目标运动的训练需求。现有定量方法多聚焦于局部变量、单次释放指标或静态模板匹配，对个性化训练支持不足，且忽视了有意义的运动变异性。
AI.method: 系统采用Kinect 2.0深度传感器和光学相机进行无标记动作捕捉，从三连杆协调、释放速度、多关节角度配置和姿势稳定性4个维度提取18个运动学特征。开发两个核心模块：①基于历史高质量样本与最小jerk准则的个性化最优投掷轨迹模型；②基于z分数和层次逻辑的运动偏差诊断与推荐模型。数据采集自专业和非专业运动员共2396个投掷样本。
AI.result: 系统生成符合自然人体运动特征的平滑个性化参考轨迹。案例研究表明该系统可检测躯干稳定性不足、肘部异常位移、速度控制失衡等问题，并能提供针对性建议。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将飞镖评估范式从"偏离统一标准"转变为"偏离个体最优控制范围"，提升了训练个性化和可解释性，对飞镖及其他高精度目标运动具有推广价值。

title: Property-Level Flood Risk Assessment Using AI-Enabled Street-View Lowest Floor Elevation Extraction and ML Imputation Across Texas
summary: This paper argues that AI-enabled analysis of street-view imagery, complemented by performance-gated machine-learning imputation, provides a viable pathway for generating building-specific elevation data at regional scale for flood risk assessment. We develop and apply a three-stage pipeline across 18 areas of interest (AOIs) in Texas that (1) extracts LFE and the height difference between street grade and the lowest floor (HDSL) from Google Street View imagery using the Elev-Vision framework, (2) imputes missing HDSL values with Random Forest and Gradient Boosting models trained on 16 terrain, hydrologic, geographic, and flood-exposure features, and (3) integrates the resulting elevation dataset with Fathom 1-in-100 year inundation surfaces and USACE depth-damage functions to estimate property-specific interior flood depth and expected loss. Across 12,241 residential structures, street-view imagery was available for 73.4% of parcels and direct LFE/HDSL extraction was successful for 49.0% (5,992 structures). Imputation was retained for 13 AOIs where cross-validated performance was defensible, with selected models achieving R suqre values from 0.159 to 0.974; five AOIs were explicitly excluded from prediction because performance was insufficient. The results show that street-view-based elevation mapping is not universally available for every property, but it is sufficiently scalable to materially improve regional flood-risk characterization by moving beyond hazard exposure to structure-level estimates of interior inundation and expected damage. Scientifically, the study advances LFE estimation from a pilot-scale proof of concept to a regional, end-to-end workflow. Practically, it offers a replicable framework for jurisdictions that lack comprehensive Elevation Certificates but need parcel-level information to support mitigation, planning, and flood-risk management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一条"街景影像AI提取 + 性能门控机器学习插补"的建筑高程数据生产路径：借助 Elev-Vision 框架从 Google 街景中提取楼层高度（LFE）与街道地坪到首层的高差（HDSL），再用基于16项地形/水文/地理/洪水暴露特征的随机森林与梯度提升模型插补缺失值，最终与 Fathom 百年一遇淹没水面及 USACE 深度-损失函数结合，估算地块级室内洪水深度与预期损失，为缺乏高程证书（FEMA Elevation Certificate）的辖区提供可复制的区域级洪水风险刻画手段。
AI.motivation: 传统洪水风险评估多依赖 FEMA 高程证书（Elevation Certificate）等逐栋测量资料，但绝大多数辖区该类数据覆盖率极低或完全缺失，导致风险刻画只能停留在"灾害暴露"层面，无法给出建筑内部实际进水深度与损失。已有基于街景的 LFE 提取研究仅处于试点规模的概念验证（pilot-scale proof of concept），未证明其可扩展到区域尺度，也缺少与插补、淹没水深到损失转换相衔接的端到端流程。因此作者希望检验：街景影像驱动的建筑高程反演能否在区域尺度上规模化生成地块级高程数据，并通过严格性能门控（performance gating）控制插补的可靠性。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线，覆盖德州 18 个 AOI（12,241 栋住宅）。阶段一：基于 Elev-Vision 框架从 Google Street View 影像中提取 LFE 与 HDSL。阶段二：对缺失的 HDSL，用随机森林与梯度提升模型进行插补，特征包括地形、水文、地理与洪水暴露共 16 项（如地形起伏、距河道距离、汇水面积、地形湿度指数、历史淹没暴露等），并通过交叉验证计算 R² 作为性能门控——仅当表现可辩护时保留插补结果，不达标 AOI 明确排除。阶段三：将插补后的高程数据集与 Fathom 1-in-100 年淹没淹没面（inundation surfaces）叠加，并结合 USACE 深度-损失函数（depth-damage functions），估算特定建筑内部淹没水深与预期损失。
AI.result: 街景影像可用性覆盖 73.4% 的地块（12,241 栋中的约 8,984 栋），直接 LFE/HDSL 提取成功率为 49.0%（5,992 栋）。插补仅在 13 个 AOI 中保留，各 AOI 选定模型的 R² 介于 0.159 至 0.974，跨 AOI 差异显著；5 个 AOI 因交叉验证性能不足被明确排除出预测。结果表明街景高程反演并非对每一栋建筑都可得，但其可扩展性足以在区域尺度上显著改善洪水风险刻画，把评估从"暴露度"推进到"建筑内部进水量与预期损失"的结构体层面估计。
AI.conclusion: 科学上，研究将基于街景的 LFE 估计从试点级概念验证推进为区域级端到端工作流；实践上，为缺乏全面高程证书的管辖区提供了可复制的框架，用于减灾、规划与洪水风险管理。作者同时强调方法局限：并非所有建筑都能获得街景提取的高程，低 R² AOI 需被剔除，插补结果应视为带不确定性的区域级估计而非替代实测高程证书的权威数据；未来可结合更高分辨率街景覆盖率、更多标签样本与不确定度量化进一步改进。

title: Reasoning Shift: How Context Silently Shortens LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibiting test-time scaling behavior, such as extended reasoning traces and self-verification, have demonstrated remarkable performance on complex, long-term reasoning tasks. However, the robustness of these reasoning behaviors remains underexplored. To investigate this, we conduct a systematic evaluation of multiple reasoning models across three scenarios: (1) problems augmented with lengthy, irrelevant context; (2) multi-turn conversational settings with independent tasks; and (3) problems presented as a subtask within a complex task. We observe an interesting phenomenon: reasoning models tend to produce much shorter reasoning traces (up to 50%) for the same problem under different context conditions compared to the traces produced when the problem is presented in isolation. A finer-grained analysis reveals that this compression is associated with a decrease in self-verification and uncertainty management behaviors, such as double-checking. While this behavioral shift does not compromise performance on straightforward problems, it might affect performance on more challenging tasks. We hope our findings draw additional attention to both the robustness of reasoning models and the problem of context management for LLMs and LLM-based agents.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一个被忽视的现象：推理型 LLM 在面对同一问题时，只要上下文中存在无关内容（长前缀无关文本、多轮无关对话、或作为复杂任务的子任务），其推理链长度会显著缩短（平均最多减少 74%），且这种缩短主要来自"找到首个候选答案之后"的验证与不确定性管理（自我检查）环节被抑制。作者称其为"推理偏移"（Reasoning Shift）。该现象会削弱模型的自校验能力、抬高其自评置信度、降低难题准确率，且提示词与定向 SFT 只能部分缓解。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展（test-time scaling）使 LLM 具备长思维链、回溯、自我验证等高阶推理行为，这些行为是其在复杂长期推理任务上表现优异的关键。但学界对这种推理行为的"鲁棒性"（是否会被上下文条件系统性改变）缺乏研究。同时，长上下文模型与长时程 Agent 大量涌现，模型常常在包含大量无关文档、工具输出、既往尝试的"污染"上下文中处理一个自包含的子问题——因此核心问题是：当模型在无关上下文环绕下解决一个隔离子问题时，是否还能像在纯净环境中一样解题？此前关于长上下文的研究多聚焦于检索失败、错误假设难以恢复等性能下降，未考察推理过程本身（行为分布与轨迹结构）的漂移。
AI.method: 以"同一问题在不同上下文条件下"的受控对照实验为核心，构造四种设置：Baseline（单条标准提示）、Subtask（单条消息含两个独立问题）、Long Input（前缀 64k token 莎士比亚戏剧等无关文本）、Multi-turn（多轮历史，仅评测第二轮）。基准为 IMOAnswerBench（400 道奥赛级数学题，用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 作 AnswerAutoGrader 判分）、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench（代码）与 MATH-500，模型含 Qwen3.5-27B、gpt-oss-120b、Gemma 4 31B、Gemini 3 Flash Preview、Kimi K2 Thinking，统一 80k 思考预算与固定供应商；同时用 Olmo3 不同后训练阶段检查点（MATH-500）分析该效应的形成阶段与"思考模式 vs 非思考模式"的差异。分析层面：(1) 定位推理链中"首个候选答案"出现位置，拆分"求解段"与"验证段"；(2) 沿用 Venhoff et al. (2025) 的句子级功能标注框架（问题设定/规划/事实检索/主动计算/结果整合/不确定性管理/最终答案陈述），计算推理链标签转移概率矩阵并作差；(3) 重采样实验——截断推理链末 64 token，在不同上下文条件下重新采样，比较"已完成"比例与"Wait/But/Alternatively/Maybe"等自验证词频；(4) 用 Kumaran et al. 的自置信度提示做干预，测量言语化置信度在基线 vs 非基线上下文下的差异；(5) "Wait, let's check everything again" 强制自检干预，比较保留/移除无关上下文的增益。缓解实验：最大推理努力提示词微调；在 Dolci-Think-SFT-7B 的 10% 子集上注入无关上下文做定向 SFT（7864 步、8.24B token、8×H100 约一天），评测 Multi-turn(16/32)、Long Input(32) 及 GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-Pro。统计检验用配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验、单侧 McNemar 检验与 Mann-Whitney U 检验。
AI.result: 1) 所有模型在非基线条件下推理 token 数大幅下降（最多 -74%，Long Input 条件下 IMOAnswerBench 上 p<10^-10），并伴随准确率下降（IMOAnswerBench 上 9%–15%），GPQA-Diamond 与 LiveCodeBench 同趋势（如 gpt-oss-120b 在 Subtask 下 78.3→64.0，LiveCodeBench 89→51/86）。2) 降幅集中在"首个候选答案之后"：Qwen3-32B 总 token -12.4%（Long Input），但答案后段 -36.1%；多轮 -5.5% vs -21.1%。3) 转移矩阵显示"最终答案陈述→思维链结束"的转移由 57% 升至 68%（p=0.0011），即基线更常发起额外自检。4) 重采样实验：几乎完成的推理链在非基线上下文下更早结束（Long Input 46% vs Baseline 21%），"Wait"/"But"/"Alternatively"/"Maybe" 频次显著降低（如 "But" 46%→20%）。5) 言语化置信度被抬高：同一推理链在 Baseline 下获得最高置信分（90.4%）的比例低于 Long Input(16k)（86.7%）等非基线条件（p<0.001），且在前半段推理中即已出现；置信度估计对 OOD 上下文不鲁棒。6) "Wait" 干预能部分恢复准确率与推理长度（Qwen3.5-27B：67.8→68.5→69.3 vs 基线 74.5），但移除无关上下文的干预明显更有效，说明冗余上下文本身削弱自检效率。7) 上下文越长缩短越明显（Qwen3.5-27B 仅数百 token 干扰即 -18%，更大提示下 -50%），多轮轮数增加同样单调递减；非思考模式也缩短 19%，但远弱于思考模式的 53%。8) 准确率损失集中在中/难题目（易题近乎无损），表明"减少过度思考"在简单题上有益，难题上则有害。9) 缓解：最大努力提示词仅带来 10–15% 相对增长，缩短比例几乎不变（如 gpt-oss-120b 仍 -51%）；定向 SFT 后推理长度接近基线（如 Multi-turn(32) 由 1,611→2,606 token，基线 2,671）但准确率仍低于基线（89.8 vs 96.1），即"模仿高层模式容易，维持长推理的有效性难"。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明推理 LLM 的高阶行为模式（自我验证、不确定性管理）在分布外/冗余上下文下是脆弱的：无关上下文会静默地"缩短"推理链，抑制自检与回溯，并系统性抬高模型的言语化置信度，从而在中等及困难任务上造成准确率损失。该现象对依赖长上下文与长时程 Agent 的系统有直接工程含义——性能退化不仅来自信息检索失败，还来自推理过程本身被"截短"。缓解手段上，仅靠提示词几乎无效，定向 SFT 能恢复推理长度（结构层面的模仿）却难以恢复长推理的实际有效性，说明真正需要的是上下文管理（压缩、摘要、外部记忆、子任务委派/递归自调用等）而非单纯延长思考。作者承认局限：上下文条件为合成且简单（未含真实 Agent 场景），缺乏机制性（内部表征层面）解释，也未提出上下文管理方法；未来工作应关注真实场景与机制分析。

title: Bridging the Simulation-to-Experiment Gap with Generative Models using Adversarial Distribution Alignment
summary: A fundamental challenge in science and engineering is the simulation-to-experiment gap. While we often possess prior knowledge of physical laws, these physical laws can be too difficult to solve exactly for complex systems. Such systems are commonly modeled using simulators, which impose computational approximations. Meanwhile, experimental measurements more faithfully represent the real world, but experimental data typically consists of observations that only partially reflect the system's full underlying state. We propose a data-driven distribution alignment framework that bridges this simulation-to-experiment gap by pre-training a generative model on fully observed (but imperfect) simulation data, then aligning it with partial (but real) observations of experimental data. While our method is domain-agnostic, we ground our approach in the physical sciences by introducing Adversarial Distribution Alignment (ADA). This method aligns a generative model of atomic positions -- initially trained on a simulated Boltzmann distribution -- with the distribution of experimental observations. We prove that our method recovers the target observable distribution, even with multiple, potentially correlated observables. We also empirically validate our framework on synthetic, molecular, and experimental protein data, demonstrating that it can align generative models with diverse observables. Our code is available at https://kaityrusnelson.com/ada/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"对抗分布对齐"（ADA）框架：在模拟（sim）数据上预训练扩散生成模型，再仅用实验提供的部分观测（如RDF、NMR、cryo-EM图像）与多个可相关观测量的完整边缘分布做对抗式对齐，从而弥合simulation-to-experiment gap；理论证明鞍点存在唯一且随判别器权重增大渐近恢复目标观测分布，实验在合成高斯混合、MD17小分子（GFN2-xTB→DFT）与Trp-cage/BBL蛋白cryo-EM对齐上均显著优于仅匹配矩的期望对齐（EA）。
AI.motivation: 科学计算中存在"模拟—实验鸿沟"：物理定律虽已知，但复杂体系无法精确求解，只能用含计算近似的模拟器；而真实实验数据虽然更接近现实，却通常只是系统完整状态的部分观测（partial observations），且数据稀缺、噪声大、测量昂贵。现有方法各有缺陷：条件生成需要成对数据、且无法处理多观测量仅有边缘分布的情形；期望对齐（EA/guidance/IBI类）只匹配有限阶矩的期望，在实践中无法恢复多峰分布；纯模拟方法则继承了模拟器的近似误差。因此需要一个既能利用模拟数据作为物理先验、又能用真实数据纠正逼近误差、并且能对多个（可能相关的）观测量做完整分布对齐的方法。
AI.method: 问题形式化：观测量 o^(i): X→R^{k_i}，目标是在KL正则化下寻找满足 o^(i)_# μ_θ = o^(i)_# ν（所有 i）的分布，即"基分布到可行集的信息投影"。ADA将其转为对偶/极小极大问题：以"可观测Wasserstein距离" d^(i)(μ,ν)=sup_{f∈Lips(1)}(E_{o#μ}[f]−E_{o#ν}[f]) 替代硬约束，得到软目标 −D_KL(μ_θ‖μ_base) − β Σ_i d^(i)(μ_θ, ν)；每个观测量配一个Lipschitz-1判别器（梯度惩罚或谱归一化），交替执行生成器上升（adjoint matching，无需反传采样过程）与判别器下降。生成器与基模型均参数化为扩散模型（Transformer编码器），观测量取RDF、键长、Rg、氢键距离、cryo-EM图像等。对比分析了条件生成与期望对齐（EA）在多观测量边缘分布下的失效原因，并说明有限矩族无法唯一确定多峰分布。
AI.result: 理论：单观测量情形给出闭式倾斜解 μ*_θ(x)=μ_base(x)·ν(o)/μ_base(o)；一般情形证明（Thm 2.1–2.3）拉格朗日函数存在唯一鞍点（利用Sion定理、-KL的严格凹性），当 β→∞ 时各观测量Wasserstein距离→0，弱极限点满足完整推前分布约束。实验：合成8分量高斯混合（立方体顶点）上ADA的Energy W2 从1.10降至0.05、簇分配KL从0.12降至0.01，而EA即使四阶矩仍为0.70/0.05；MD17阿司匹林中GFN2-xTB→DFT对齐，随观测（MD、Rg、键长、氢键、COOH–酯距离）逐步加入，ADA的W1与自由能面JSD均优于EA，且保持未约束FES的相关结构；蛋白质实验中仅用SNR=1.0/0.1的128×128 cryo-EM图像对齐PDB结构（2JOF 29个、2WXC 21个），对留出观测量的W1最多下降86%，最大Kabsch RMSD下降，并在SNR未知时通过变分推断后验恢复真实SNR分布N(0.98,0.19)。
AI.conclusion: ADA以对抗训练方式在"多观测量、完整分布、仅边缘观测"的设定下弥合模拟—实验差距：模拟数据作为KL先验提供物理知识，实验观测提供分布层面的纠正，随观测数量增加对齐效果持续改善，且天然适用于高维噪声观测与前向模型参数未知的情形。其局限包括：adjoint matching要求可观测量可微；理论保证依赖紧Polish空间、连续观测量与D_KL(ν‖μ_base)<∞等条件；当前仅处理由单一状态导出的静态观测量，动态可观测量（如自相关函数）留待未来；实验数据规模远小于真实生物分子研究前沿。总体上是领域无关的"从部分观测学习"通用框架，可扩展到更大规模实验数据集与计算资源。

title: NeuroDDAF: Neural Dynamic Diffusion-Advection Fields with Evidential Fusion for Air Quality Forecasting
summary: Accurate air quality forecasting is crucial for protecting public health and guiding environmental policy, yet it remains challenging due to nonlinear spatiotemporal dynamics, wind-driven transport, and distribution shifts across regions. Physics-based models are interpretable but computationally expensive and often rely on restrictive assumptions, whereas purely data-driven models can be accurate but may lack robustness and calibrated uncertainty. To address these limitations, we propose Neural Dynamic Diffusion-Advection Fields (NeuroDDAF), a physics-informed forecasting framework that unifies neural representation learning with open-system transport modeling. NeuroDDAF integrates (i) a GRU-Graph Attention encoder to capture temporal dynamics and wind-aware spatial interactions, (ii) a Fourier-domain diffusion-advection module with learnable residuals, (iii) a wind-modulated latent Neural ODE to model continuous-time evolution under time-varying connectivity, and (iv) an evidential fusion mechanism that adaptively combines physics-guided and neural forecasts while quantifying uncertainty. Experiments on four urban datasets (Beijing, Shenzhen, Tianjin, and Ancona) across 1-3 day horizons show that NeuroDDAF consistently outperforms strong baselines, including AirPhyNet, achieving up to 9.7% reduction in RMSE and 9.4% reduction in MAE on long-term forecasts. On the Beijing dataset, NeuroDDAF attains an RMSE of 41.63 $μ$g/m$^3$ for 1-day prediction and 48.88 $μ$g/m$^3$ for 3-day prediction, representing the best performance among all compared methods. In addition, NeuroDDAF improves cross-city generalization and yields well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, as confirmed by ensemble variance analysis and case studies under varying wind conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeuroDDAF，一种结合神经表示学习与开放系统传输建模的物理信息天气预报框架，在四个城市数据集上实现最佳性能，1-3天预报RMSE降低达9.7%。
AI.motivation: 空气质量的准确预报对公共健康保护和环境政策制定至关重要，但面临非线性时空动态、风驱传输和跨区域分布偏移等挑战。现有方法存在局限：物理模型可解释但计算成本高且依赖限制性假设，数据驱动模型准确但缺乏鲁棒性和校准的不确定性。
AI.method: NeuroDDAF框架包含四个核心组件：1) GRU-图注意力编码器捕获时空动态和风感知空间交互；2) 傅里叶域扩散-平流模块带可学习残差；3) 风调制潜在神经ODE建模时变连通性下的连续时间演化；4) 证据融合机制自适应结合物理引导和神经预报同时量化不确定性。
AI.result: 在北京、深圳、天津和安科纳四个城市数据集上，1-3天预报 horizons下，NeuroDDAF始终优于包括AirPhyNet在内的强基线模型，RMSE降低达9.7%，MAE降低达9.4%。北京数据集：1天预报RMSE为41.63 μg/m³，3天预报为48.88 μg/m³，在所有对比方法中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: NeuroDDAF在长期预报中表现优异，提升了跨城市泛化能力，并通过集成方差分析和不同风条件下的案例研究证实了校准良好的不确定性估计。
